# WPScan

`wpscan` &middot; _web-applications_

Scans a WordPress site for vulnerable plugins, themes and users.

**Moderate impact.** It touches the target directly; keep the scope tight.

## What this tool needs

- A WordPress site you are authorised to test.
- Ruby and its gems (bundled in the runtime image).
- Installed on demand from the Kali repository.

## How to use it

Runs version, plugin and user enumeration against WordPress. Without a WPScan API token the vulnerability feed is limited. Use only on sites you own or manage.

## Examples

```console
$ wpscan --url https://example.com
$ wpscan --url https://example.com --enumerate vp
```

## At a glance

- Category: `web-applications`
- Install with: `apt install wpscan`
- Baseline: no
- Licence: WPScan licence (source-available; see upstream)
